name: a-symlinked-root-still-names-its-files
breaks: every source-scanning Swift suite stops working from a git worktree. The root a file was compiled from and the path an enumerator hands back disagree by a leading /private, so no file comes out as being inside the root at all (#941, L251). Pointed at the DIRECT caller of relativePath: the sweep test cannot prove this line, because files(under:) resolves the root before it walks and passes the resolved root down, so the line has nothing left to do by the time it runs (L1)
